rules.text: We are unfortunately unable to process returns or refunds once merchandise has been accepted.
rules.quote: Due to the care we put forth for every order, we are unfortunately unable to process returns or refunds once merchandise has been accepted.

rules.text: You may cancel anytime up to the day of pick-up or delivery.
rules.quote: If you have concerns about your order, you may cancel anytime up to the day of pick-up or delivery.

rules.text: We reserve the right to repair or replace your furniture as deemed necessary at our sole discretion.
rules.quote: Please note that we reserve the right to repair or replace your furniture as deemed necessary at our sole discretion.

rules.text: A return request must be made within 72 hours of receiving your item(s).
rules.quote: A return request must be made within 72 hours of receiving your item(s) by calling 888-729-6687.

rules.text: Only items labeled "Free Shipping" qualify for return.
rules.quote: Only items labeled "Free Shipping" qualify for return.

rules.text: Assembled or modified items are unable to be returned.
rules.quote: Assembled or modified items are unable to be returned.

rules.text: A restocking fee of 15% of the merchandise total will be applied to returned free shipping items.
rules.quote: A restocking fee of 15% of the merchandise total will be applied to returned items.

rules.text: Changes after three days will result in the loss of your 20% deposit.
rules.quote: Changes after this period will result in the loss of your 20% deposit.

rules.text: After seven days from notification of arrival, a 5% storage fee per week may be assessed.
rules.quote: After seven days, you may be assessed a 5% storage fee per week.

rules.text: All area rug returns require a restocking fee of 10%.
rules.quote: Please note: all returns will be reviewed for approval and require a restocking fee of 10%.
